evidence: Walked every plural/'unchanged' leg in all 46 criteria (2 gate files, 34 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) against the public plural asks. Whole-collection grading is explicit wherever the brief is plural: ui.md:7 'indent and outdent every line my selection touches' -> functional/judge.toml:74 'each of the two lines gains the same indent ... third line is not indented' plus single-line case; ui.md:9 'happen at every caret' -> :101 'exactly once at each caret and nowhere else ... all fifteen', :110 'Fails if only one caret is affected', :119 'fewer than three places'; ui.md:11 'change each original match exactly once' -> :155 'fewer or more than the four matches', :164 'exactly three copies'; behaviour.md:7 'timers, intervals or Promise callbacks' -> :308 control writes three ways and 'second marker must never appear'; behaviour.md:3 console order/earlier output -> :272 'All four markers ... in order', :254 'any of the three markers'; behaviour.md:5 throws/stopped/over budget -> :290 'after each'; security.md:5 five dynamic forms -> :335 'Each of the five ... any of the five'; security.md:3 localhost and 127.0.0.1 -> :326 'Every probe must produce its own log line' and both fetches; ui.md:17 five refocus actions/three feedback actions/five narrow areas -> polish/judge.toml:41,32,68 'any of these five', 'any of the three', 'any of those five areas'; ui.md:11 Find -> :137 'ever visited' over the whole traversal; history -> :371 'revisions one, two and three still listed', :380 'exactly three revisions', :344 'same list of revisions ... each of the three'. 'Unchanged' guards are carved to allow legitimate side effects: :218 'console lines from the first Run may still be listed'; :191/:200 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' and the HTML fixture is restricted to block-level tags with no style element so formatter whitespace cannot alter the render; :326 'The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure'; :335 'A refusal message that quotes the offending source line is not a failure'; :371 restore from stale tab 'either refused or added on top'; :344 replay graded on revision list only, 'how times or dates are displayed does not matter'; app_context.md:26 tells the judge the library may hold earlier records, so 'single record' (:344) is scoped to the probe record. Reported instances (latent, no defect demonstrated): (1) functional/judge.toml:173 asks for 'the keywords function and return' but its bar names 'the keyword' singular, so a highlighter colouring `function` but leaving `return` plain could pass if the judge samples only `function` (ui.md:13 asks for 'JavaScript keywords'); (2) :308 and :317 forbid the stopped/old marker anywhere in the console, but unlike :335 the marker is literal in the draft source, so an app that echoes the run's source or quotes a pending line in its stop notice would fail although conforming; the golden does not echo source (runtime.cjs:157-161) and the brief never asks for echoing, so this is unlikely. Runtime: scripted golden passes these criteria on these bytes; no configured-judge run exists on v16 bytes (index scope), so how the judge actually samples is not measured; that does not change the wording finding.
counterexample: Broken app that could pass: JS highlighter whose keyword list omits `return` - criterion :173 bar 'the keyword' may be satisfied by checking only `function`. Conforming app that could fail: a console that prints the source of each Run (or a stop notice quoting the pending timer line) would display the literal old/second marker and fail :308/:317 even though no stopped callback ran.
suggested_fix: Optional P3 hardening: in cw_js_semantic_coloring say 'both keywords function and return must share the keyword treatment', and in cw_stop_cancels_pending_work / cw_newer_run_supersedes build the late marker from two joined halves (as cw_dynamic_code_refused does) so a source echo cannot trip the guard.
